task: Add fail-closed hard-budget enforcement to the Claude dispatch seam: pure budget-policy resolution + over-budget predicate + buildBlockedBudgetRecord in usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts, and a minimal gated pre-spawn guard in lattice-dispatch.ts that blocks (skips spawn) + writes a decision.kind=blocked record when a configured hard budget is exceeded. Thread the preflight estimatedInputTokens to the guard. Unset/OFF = byte-identical dispatch.
outcome: npm --prefix packages/main run test:usage-ledger-budget is all-green and proves the 4 quadrants: (a) ledger flag OFF -> no budget code runs, dispatch byte-identical (spawn happens); (b) flag ON + LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS unset -> decision proceeds with budgetPolicyId=null, spawn happens (byte-identical control flow); (c) flag ON + hard budget set + preflight estimate OVER budget -> a decision.kind=blocked record is appended AND the provider spawn is SKIPPED AND a well-formed blocked dispatch result is returned; (d) flag ON + budget set + estimate UNDER budget -> proceeds + spawns. A budget-check error PROCEEDS (does not wrongly block). Build clean; usage-ledger still imports zero other modules; the only edits are dispatch-usage.ts + the single gated guard in lattice-dispatch.ts (+ smoke + package.json).
